display.purpose: Heavy showcase headline; weight 900 also identifies the wordmark.

workspace-headline.purpose: Quieter operating hierarchy; 2rem at 640px and below.

compare-title.purpose: Showcase image captions and legend; image captions become 1.25rem on mobile.

workspace-title.purpose: Workspace comparison, results, and privacy headings.

code.purpose: JSON/CSV preview contents, never general metadata or controls.

motion.name: active-press
motion.purpose: Immediate native-button and entry-link press feedback; no transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove active movement for reduced-motion preferences.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Native Detect action; real workspace disables it until ready and while locked.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:44px; border:1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent-ink); padding:var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); font:500 1rem/1.55 var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:enabled { background:var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Native workspace actions including result downloads, cancellation, and deletion.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height:44px; border:1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-sheet); color:var(--color-ink); padding:var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); font:500 1rem/1.55 var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-paper-3); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-secondary:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Detector entry link
components.description: Substantial orange navigation, not a fake upload control or cross-route file transfer.
components.css: .ds-entry { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:372px; max-width:100%; min-height:64px; padding:var(--space-sm) var(--space-xl); border:1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent-ink); font:500 1.75rem/1.55 var(--font-body); text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-entry:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-entry:active { transform:translateY(1px); } @media (max-width:640px) { .ds-entry { width:auto; min-height:52px; font-size:1.125rem; padding-inline:var(--space-lg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-entry:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Native file input
components.description: Labeled native picker with linked help; media selection does not trigger inference.
components.html: PNG, JPG, BMP, WebP. Up to 10 MB and 12 megapixels.
components.css: .ds-upload { color:var(--color-ink); font:400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-body); } .ds-upload label { display:block; margin-bottom:var(--space-sm); font-weight:500; font-size:.9375rem; } .ds-upload input { width:100%; color:var(--color-ink); font:400 .875rem/1.55 var(--font-body); } .ds-upload input::file-selector-button { min-height:44px; margin-right:var(--space-sm); padding:var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border:1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-sheet); color:var(--color-ink); font:500 .875rem/1.55 var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; } .ds-upload input::file-selector-button:hover { background:var(--color-paper-3); } .ds-upload input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-upload input:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-upload p { color:var(--color-muted); font-size:.8125rem; margin-block:var(--space-sm); }

components.name: Native object selection
components.description: Native checkbox with associated label and a detection-not-transcription note.
components.css: .ds-types { min-width:0; margin:0; padding:0; border:0; color:var(--color-ink); font:500 .9375rem/1.55 var(--font-body); } .ds-types legend { padding:0; margin-bottom:var(--space-sm); } .ds-types label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--space-sm); min-height:48px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-types input { width:20px; height:20px; flex-shrink:0; margin:0; accent-color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-types input:hover { cursor:pointer; } .ds-types input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-types input:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-types small { display:block; color:var(--color-muted); font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:400; }

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Underlined semantic links with current-page indication; mobile is a navigation row.
components.html: ProjectDetectorGitHub
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:var(--space-xl); color:var(--color-ink); font:500 1.25rem/1.55 var(--font-body); } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; gap:var(--space-sm); color:inherit; text-underline-offset:.25em; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav svg { width:18px; height:18px; } @media (max-width:640px) { .ds-nav { width:100%; justify-content:space-between; gap:var(--space-md); font-size:.9375rem; } }

components.name: Workspace comparison
components.description: Instructional empty source/result pair; actual media replaces the wells, never fabricated annotations.
components.css: .ds-comparison { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:var(--space-lg); padding:var(--space-lg); border:1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius:var(--radius-panel); background:var(--color-sheet); color:var(--color-ink); font:400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-body); } .ds-comparison figure { min-width:0; margin:0; } .ds-comparison figcaption { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:var(--space-xs); margin-bottom:var(--space-md); } .ds-comparison h2 { margin:0; font:600 1.5rem/1.15 var(--font-display); } .ds-comparison figcaption span { color:var(--color-muted); font-size:.8125rem; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-stage { min-height:260px; aspect-ratio:4/3; display:grid; place-items:center; background:var(--color-paper-3); } .ds-stage p { margin-block:var(--space-sm); padding:var(--space-lg); text-align:center; color:var(--color-muted); } @media (max-width:640px) { .ds-comparison { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); padding:var(--space-md); } .ds-stage { min-height:180px; } }

components.css: .ds-data { min-width:0; border:1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius:var(--radius-panel); background:var(--color-sheet); color:var(--color-ink); overflow:clip; } .ds-data h3 { margin:0; padding:var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule); font:500 1rem/1.4 var(--font-body); } .ds-data pre { height:128px; overflow:auto; margin:0; padding:var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); font:400 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-code); } .ds-data code { font:inherit; } .ds-data pre:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Detection legend markers
components.description: Non-interactive category labels with outlined swatches; not chips or toggles.
components.css: .ds-legend { margin-block:var(--space-lg); padding:0; list-style:none; color:var(--color-ink); font:400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-body); } .ds-legend li { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:var(--space-sm); margin-block:var(--space-md); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-legend-label { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--space-sm); } .ds-legend-label::before { content:''; width:20px; height:16px; border:3px solid var(--color-vehicle); border-radius:2px; } .ds-legend-label.ds-logo::before { border-color:var(--color-logo); } .ds-legend-label.ds-plate::before { border-color:var(--color-plate); } @media (max-width:1000px) { .ds-legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:var(--space-lg); margin-block:var(--space-sm); } .ds-legend li { margin:0; gap:var(--space-md); } }

narrative.overview:
Warm manila ground, dark ink rules, orange actions, heavy grotesk typography, and paired-image hierarchy describe the implemented authority. The showcase lets real source/output images lead; the detector carries the same materials into a quieter, native-control workspace. Comparison, not decoration or performance claims, supplies the emphasis.

This records shipped issue #6, approved Option A; it does not introduce a new world. Ground truth is `web/src/tokens.css`, `style.css`, `showcase.css`, `site.tsx`, `showcase.tsx`, and `main.tsx`. Product constraints live in `PRODUCT.md`; the surface-specific contract remains in `docs/design/showcase.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Warm manila ground and dark ruled structure.
Orange actions with dark ink text.
Heavy showcase grotesks; quieter workspace hierarchy.
Real paired imagery, readable data, and explicit limitations.
Native controls, visible focus, and distinct responsive layouts.

rules.name: The Dark Action Ink Rule
rules.body: Preserve dark ink on orange in both default and hover states; do not copy the comp's white button lettering.

rules.name: The Two Weights of Attention Rule
rules.body: Keep showcase display at 900 and workspace headings at 600; body text remains 400/500 and monospace remains code-only.

dos: Do preserve dark action ink, visible focus, labeled native controls, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the showcase image pair side by side on mobile while stacking the workspace comparison.
Do show real inference and matching exports, including mistakes, provenance, and temporary-result limitations.
Do retain Display 900/600, Text 400/500, and code-only monospace in their existing roles.
donts: Don't replace semantic links, buttons, inputs, tables, or disclosures with decorative imitations.
Don't invent boxes, benchmark claims, OCR, persistence, automatic retries, or new service features.
Don't add shadows, pills, decorative metadata kickers, or a new visual metaphor to this recorded system.
Don't treat photo-matching bypass or the four-fix ship verdict as a machine plate-gate pass or licensing clearance.
